tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: -subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe this conversation to one of this app's events (email.received). Matching events are delivered here as they happen and wake the agent (self-wake guard: an agent is never woken by an event it caused itself). The subscription lives in the backend — it survives restarts of this app. Subscribing again to the same event REPLACES the previous filter. Returns: { subscription: { subscriptionId, topic, event, channelId, mode, filter, wakeUpOn, createdAt }, message }.

event.description: Local event name (the app namespace is implicit). Valid: email.received — A new email arrived in the connected Gmail account.

filter.description: Optional filter. Fields AND-ed, values within a field OR-ed. Only the fields declared for the event are valid — see the event list.

wakeUpOn.description: Event names that wake the agent (response turn). Default: the subscribed event always wakes. Rarely needed with a single-event subscription.

channelId.description: Conversation that receives the events. Defaults to the calling conversation — omit it.

mode.description: notify = silent delivery, wake = trigger an agent response turn. Default: wake.

tools.name: -unsubscribe
tools.description: Cancel this conversation's subscription(s) to this app's events. By subscriptionId, by event name, or — with neither — ALL of this conversation's subscriptions to this app. Idempotent. Returns: { unsubscribed, deleted?, channelId }.

event.description: Cancel the subscription to this event.

tools.name: -list-subscriptions
tools.description: List this conversation's subscriptions to this app's events, plus the app's event catalog (events, payload fields and valid filter fields) to subscribe to. Returns: { subscriptions: [...], events: [...] }.

tools.name: list-messages
tools.description: List email messages from inbox or specific labels. Supports filtering by unread, starred, etc.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: get-message
tools.description: Get full details of a specific email message by ID. Use format="html" to get the original text/html part (inline styles, fonts, colors — e.g. to replicate a hand-written draft's formatting) or format="raw" to get the complete MIME message in base64. Default format="text" returns the plain-text body.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to retrieve

format.description: Response format: "text" (default) = plain-text body as before; "html" = original text/html part in bodyHtml (null + hasHtmlPart:false if the message has no HTML part); "raw" = full MIME message in raw (base64, Gmail API format=raw).

tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Send an email message from the specified account.

bodyFile.description: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

tools.name: reply-message
tools.description: Reply to an existing email message.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to reply to

tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search for email messages using Gmail's search syntax.

tools.name: modify-labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels from a message (e.g., mark as read/unread, archive, star).

messageId.description: The ID of the message to modify

tools.name: list-drafts
tools.description: List all draft emails in the account.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of drafts to return (default: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: create-draft
tools.description: Create a draft email message.

bodyFile.description: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

threadId.description: Gmail thread ID. When present, the draft is created as a reply INSIDE that thread (appears in the conversation in Gmail). Optional.

replyToMessageId.description: Gmail message ID being replied to. The tool fetches it and automatically derives In-Reply-To/References headers (and the threadId when none is given), so the draft threads canonically. Optional.

tools.name: delete-draft
tools.description: Delete a draft email by its draft ID.

draftId.description: The ID of the draft to delete

tools.name: update-draft
tools.description: Update an existing draft email by replacing its content.

draftId.description: The ID of the draft to update

bodyFile.description: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

threadId.description: Gmail thread ID. Moves the draft into that thread. When omitted, the current threadId of the draft is preserved automatically (an update never detaches a threaded draft). Optional.

tools.name: get-attachment
tools.description: Get the content of an email attachment by its attachment ID.

messageId.description: The ID of the message containing the attachment

attachmentId.description: The ID of the attachment to retrieve

tools.name: store-attachment
tools.description: Download and store an email attachment to the local filesystem.

messageId.description: The ID of the message containing the attachment

attachmentId.description: The ID of the attachment to store

tools.name: list-labels
tools.description: List all Gmail labels (both system and custom labels) for the account.

tools.name: create-label
tools.description: Create a new Gmail label.

tools.name: update-label
tools.description: Update an existing Gmail label (name, colors, visibility).

labelId.description: ID of the label to update

tools.name: delete-label
tools.description: Delete a Gmail label. This does NOT delete the emails with this label.

labelId.description: ID of the label to delete

tools.name: list-filters
tools.description: List all Gmail filters for the account.

tools.name: create-filter
tools.description: Create a new Gmail filter to automatically organize emails.

action.description: Actions to perform when filter matches

tools.name: delete-filter
tools.description: Delete a Gmail filter by its ID.

filterId.description: ID of the filter to delete

tools.name: start-email-watcher
tools.description: DEPRECATED (v1.4.4): the watcher is now an internal detail managed by the app — it runs automatically while any gmail.email.received subscription exists. MIGRATION: use the reserved tool `gmail__subscribe` with event "email.received" instead — subscribing IS the intent to receive emails, and the app ensures its watcher runs. This tool still works (manual override) but will be removed.

intervalMinutes.description: Polling interval in minutes (default: 5, minimum: 1). Lower values consume more Gmail API quota.

tools.name: stop-email-watcher
tools.description: DEPRECATED (v1.4.4): the watcher is now managed by the app based on active subscriptions. MIGRATION: use `gmail__unsubscribe` (event "email.received") — when the last subscription goes, the watcher stops by itself. This tool still works (manual override) but will be removed.

tools.name: get-watcher-status
tools.description: DEPRECATED (v1.4.4): the watcher is now an internal detail. MIGRATION: use `gmail__list-subscriptions` to see what this conversation is subscribed to — the watcher runs automatically while subscriptions exist. This tool still works but will be removed.

tools.name: get-stats
tools.description: Get exact mailbox statistics without pagination: messages in INBOX (total + unread), total UNREAD, STARRED count, DRAFT count, plus SPAM, TRASH, SENT and the 4 CATEGORY_* labels (PROMOTIONS, UPDATES, SOCIAL, FORUMS), and total mailbox messages/threads. Uses users.labels.get + users.getProfile — exact counts, immune to the search resultSizeEstimate cap of 100. Optionally include per-label breakdowns.

includeLabels.description: Include per-label breakdown for ALL labels (1 API call per label — can be slow with many labels). Default: false.

labelIds.description: Specific label IDs to include in the breakdown (e.g. ["INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED"]). Cheaper than includeLabels.

tools.name: set-signature
tools.description: Save the email signature (HTML) for the connected Gmail account. Overrides the account signature (Gmail sendAs) for emails sent from Teros. The signature is stored per-account and automatically appended to outgoing emails (send-message, reply-message, create-draft, update-draft) — never invented or reconstructed from other emails. If the user wants a signature and none is configured, ask them for it (HTML preferred) and save it with this tool.

signatureHtml.description: The signature as HTML (e.g. with logo , styled name, role, company). Images must use absolute https URLs.

tools.name: get-signature
tools.description: Get the email signature (HTML) for the connected Gmail account, if any. Checks the account signature (Gmail sendAs) and the Teros-stored override. Use before composing emails to check whether a signature is configured.
